hooks.command: repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$repo" ] || { echo "worker-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 0; }; bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-interactive-worker-hook.sh" claude SessionStart
repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}"; [ -n "$repo" ] || exit 0; bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-interactive-worker-hook.sh" claude SessionEnd

repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}" || { echo "stop-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 2; }; [ -f "$repo/bootstrap/run-stop-hook.sh" ] || { echo "stop-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 2; }; exec bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-stop-hook.sh"

repo="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)}" || { echo "worker-fence-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 2; }; [ -f "$repo/bootstrap/run-interactive-worker-hook.sh" ] || { echo "worker-fence-hook: cannot resolve repo root from cwd=$PWD" >&2; exit 2; }; exec /bin/bash "$repo/bootstrap/run-interactive-worker-hook.sh" claude PreToolUse
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/bootstrap/mirror.sh" to-codex "$f"; } 2>/dev/null || true
